question: Which entities are assigned to the eastern and southern petals of the pedestal?
premises: Āmoda is associated with the eastern petal.
Pramoda is associated with the southern petal.
inference: Āmoda is placed on the eastern petal and Pramoda on the southern petal.
plain_english: O brahmin, place Āmoda on the eastern petal and Pramoda on the southern petal.
